session.name: MPI-567 session 2 - the blend pass, benched across five plates

goal.original: Answer whether Boogu ImageEdit gained multi-image support, then bench the blend pass and settle a general-purpose prompt with Fabio.
goal.summary: Boogu multi-image is ANSWERED: no, and the mechanism is that Boogu has no per-image addressing token. The blend was then benched on Klein 4B end to end from Fabio's own drawing across five lighting plates. A general-purpose prompt WORKS and generalises. The localised InpaintCrop/Stitch path is BLOCKED - it leaves a visible rectangular re-grade patch on every plate. Fabio's ruling: that is a Boogu/Klein behaviour and Qwen Edit does not usually do it, so the next model to measure is Qwen, not a bigger Klein.

task_card.title: Scribble-to-object Flow - user draws on the image, ControlNet + SDXL renders it in

next_action.description: Run the whole-image-relight -> composite-back route across all five plates and confirm the rectangular re-grade patch is genuinely absent everywhere (it was absent on the two tried, and present on EVERY crop/stitch run). Then re-run the anime plate on the ILL Anime arm. If the rectangle survives the composite-back route, measure the same five plates on Qwen Edit - Fabio's read is that Qwen does not re-grade, unlike Boogu and Klein.

key_decisions: The SDXL intermediate does NOT need to survive the blend - the user never sees it (Fabio). The bar is that the object lands at the drawn LOCATION in the scene's camera angle, not that its identity is preserved. This relaxes the hardest constraint and earlier 'identity drift is a blocker' notes are downgraded.

The re-grade is MODEL-SPECIFIC: Boogu and Klein do it, Qwen Edit usually does not (Fabio). So the model axis is 'whose patch still matches its surroundings', not 'who is fastest' - which brings Qwen back into contention despite being slow.

Klein 9B is a HOPE, not a plan. Unproven, another session is still establishing whether it is even possible, and it is licence-gated (MPI-357) with verification that is a real pain for users. Do NOT design around it landing.

Medium is a MODEL-SELECTION problem, not a prompt problem. 'Match the scene's art style' does not restyle a photoreal object onto a cel-shaded plate. Fabio: 'If you want anime, you gotta use ILL Anime.' This makes the any-of picker load-bearing for correctness, not a convenience.

Canny's real niche is a SHADED PENCIL SKETCH (tonal hatching), not tidy line art. 'Structured' in the acceptance text means TONAL, not TIDY - the step copy must say so or users with clean line art will pick canny and get outlines.
constraints: THE BLOCKER: the localised InpaintCrop/Stitch path leaves a visible lighter RECTANGLE around the object on every plate, worst on large uniform backgrounds (dirt road, anime rooftop). It appears on BOTH preprocessor arms, so it is the stitch, not the render. Not shippable as it stands.

CANNY KEEPS THE USER'S INK. Canny detects EDGES and a drawn stroke has TWO of them, so a 3px line becomes two parallel contours the model renders as an outline. Scribble thins to a centreline and renders a FORM. Input_Control_Net: 1 = scribble, 2 = canny.

Relighting CANNOT be done inside a crop. The model cannot match a grade it cannot see, so a tight crop returns a blown-out patch. This is why boogu_edit_balanced.json's localised-edit path is NOT the carrier for this flow.

Klein's edit pass CHANGES DIMENSIONS (snaps to /32) and the two axes do not scale by the same factor - 896x1200 in, 880x1184 out; 736x1168 in, 816x1296 out. Any composite-back must handle the resize or the region lands off by pixels.

The session-1 preview mpi567_cutout_00001_.png ALPHA IS NOT A SILHOUETTE - ~90% opaque, corners at 254, so getbbox() returns the whole frame and a crop silently does nothing. Derive the object from non-white RGB instead. Cost two bad fixtures here.

ANOTHER SESSION IS LIVE IN THIS TREE working MPI-357 (Klein 9B licence gate): routes/licences.js, licences/, MpiLicenceGate, licences.js, models.js, server.js, downloadService.js, MpiModelManager.js, docs/download-manager.md, docs/model-library.md. Do not touch or commit those. js/data/modelConstants/models.js also carries a THIRD session's enhanceRecipe work (MPI-25).

Bench is port 8188, app engine is 48188. Never drive the user's app on :3000. Windows Python from the Bash tool: use a .py FILE, never a heredoc (it hangs), and wrap stdout in utf-8 or printing dies with a cp1252 charmap error.
